title: BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier with AUC Surrogate Refit
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments into word and punctuation tokens, truncates to 200 tokens, builds a training-only vocabulary from tokens occurring at least twice, and maps other tokens to UNK. A word embedding layer with spatial dropout feeds two bidirectional LSTMs. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated and passed through two residual ReLU dense layers and a scalar toxicity-logit head. Training uses soft continuous targets and binary cross-entropy for three epochs, with length-bucketed shuffled batches, Adam, mixed precision, gradient clipping, and linearly decayed learning rate. It then refits the network using sampled identity/toxicity strata and random rows. This loss maximizes a differentiable, confidence-weighted pairwise AUC surrogate combining overall, subgroup, BPSN, and BNSP terms through a negative-power mean, while retaining a weighted BCE anchor. Inference batches comments by length and returns sigmoid probabilities.
